scope: Hair F10 swept-clump cross-section frames only
trigger: A delivery claims continuous bend/twist or no frame discontinuity across sampled bundle sections.
mustNever: Pairwise axis dot products greater than zero are treated as proof of smooth twist.
A nonzero maximum authored twist substitutes for a local angular-rate bound.
Uniform curve parameter samples are assumed to be uniform arc-length samples.
A global hairstyle-independent twist-rate threshold is invented after seeing the candidate.
A synthetic false-positive mechanism is reported as an observed production artifact.
Frame continuity expands into hairstyle, shape, strand, material, dynamics or user acceptance.
requiredEvidence: exact source, subject and run identity
section centers, tangents, width axes, thickness axes and authored twist values
signed unwrapped twist increments normalized by arc length
a task-specific twist-rate budget frozen before the gate run
forward-versus-reversed transport error and pre-frozen tolerance
a high-frequency sawtooth positive control that passes the old dot-product predicate but is rejected by the candidate gate
independent verifier identity or explicit UNKNOWN
boundedHypothesis: If the claimed continuity is real rather than a sampling artifact, then an injected <90-degree-per-step sawtooth must fail an arc-length-normalized rate gate, and 65/129-section plus forward/reverse evaluations must agree within tolerances frozen before the run.
activationGate: Hair Mother implements the receipt fields and independent verifier runs this case on one immutable F10 descendant; coordinator review is required before activation.
rollback: Remove the candidate receipt/check only; preserve F10 geometry and existing width, thickness, conservation and native-rebind evidence.
